# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **$9.5M in eCat GMV across 7,684 orders** — RENWIL's trailing-12-month eCat commerce reached $9.5M with a $1,236 average order value, all routed through iPad by field reps. [→ §commerce]
2. **6.6x order volume ramp in six months** — Monthly eCat orders grew from 137 in April 2025 to 898 in October 2025, demonstrating rapid field team adoption of the platform. [→ §commerce]
3. **Quote orders deliver a 3.9x AOV premium** — Quotes represent just 2.2% of order volume but 8.4% of GMV over the trailing 12 months, at $4,817 per quote versus $1,236 overall. [→ §commerce]
4. **Well-diversified buyer base** — No single customer exceeds 9% of eCat GMV; top five account for 22.5% over the trailing 12 months. [→ §commerce]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **MEDIUM**: Expand quoting workflow adoption across the rep team to capture more high-value project opportunities — even a modest increase in quote volume at the current $4,817 AOV could meaningfully lift overall GMV [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §commerce]
